_meta.note: Source language. Every value is a whole sentence or a standalone label: never insert names, numbers or medicine names into these strings. Other language files mirror these keys; each entry needs reviewedBy from a native speaker before the language can ship.

app.tagline.text: When a parent misses their medicine, the right person in the family knows.

app.notMedicalAdvice.text: Reminders and family alerts only. This is not medical advice.

parent.prompt.morning.text: It is time for your morning medicine.

parent.prompt.afternoon.text: It is time for your afternoon medicine.

parent.prompt.evening.text: It is time for your evening medicine.

parent.prompt.night.text: It is time for your night medicine.

parent.undoHint.text: Tapped by mistake? You can undo this for a few seconds.

parent.important.text: This medicine is important. Please do not skip it.

parent.familyToldTaken.text: Your family has been told that you took it.

parent.join.title.text: Enter the code your family sent you.

parent.join.invalid.text: This code did not work. Please ask your family for a new one.

parent.join.done.text: This phone is connected. Your family can now set your reminders.

parent.notify.why.text: Allow notifications so your medicine reminders can reach this phone.

parent.notify.blocked.text: Notifications are turned off for this app. Please ask your family to help turn them on.

parent.notify.ready.text: Reminders are on for this phone.

alert.missed.text: The medicine has not been confirmed yet. The reminder did reach the phone.

alert.offline.text: The medicine has not been confirmed yet. The phone seems to be offline.

alert.claimedByYou.text: You are handling this. Everyone else has been told.

alert.notYourTurn.text: Someone earlier in the family order has been asked first.

alert.parentTookIt.text: The medicine has now been confirmed as taken.

timeline.reminder_sent.text: Reminder sent to the parent's phone.

timeline.reminder_reached_phone.text: The reminder had reached the phone, so this is a missed dose.

timeline.phone_seemed_offline.text: The reminder never reached the phone, so it may be offline.

timeline.member_alerted.text: Family member alerted, in the family's chosen order.

timeline.family_alerted.text: Nobody responded in time, so everyone was alerted.

timeline.claimed.text: Claimed: this person is handling it.

timeline.others_stood_down.text: Everyone else was told to stand down.

timeline.family_told_taken.text: The family was told the medicine was taken.

timeline.nobody_responded.text: Nobody responded. The dose is marked unresolved.

common.offline.text: You are offline. Changes will be sent when you reconnect.

common.error.text: Something went wrong. Please try again.

install.title.text: First, add DoseCircle to your home screen.

install.why.text: Reminders only reach this phone once the app is on the home screen.

install.ios.step1.text: Tap the Share button at the bottom of Safari.

install.ios.step2.text: Scroll down and tap Add to Home Screen.

install.ios.step3.text: Open DoseCircle from the home screen and enter the code again.

install.android.manual.text: Open the browser menu and tap Add to Home screen or Install app.

install.keepCode.text: Keep this code. You will need it inside the app.

install.done.text: The app is on the home screen.

parent.home.notConnected.text: This phone is not connected yet.

parent.home.battery.text: To get reminders on time, ask your family to turn off battery saving for this app.

auth.title.signIn.text: Sign in to your family circle

auth.switchToSignIn.text: Already have an account? Sign in

auth.confirmTitle.text: Enter the code we emailed you.

auth.notConfigured.text: Sign-in is not set up for this copy of the app. Try the live demo instead.

auth.parentHint.text: Setting up a parent's phone? Parents do not need an account. Open the link your family sent.

scan.help.text: Point the camera at the code on your family's screen.

scan.denied.text: The camera is blocked. Allow it for this site in your browser settings, or type the code instead.

scan.noCamera.text: No camera is available here. Type the code instead.

scan.notOurs.text: That isn't a DoseCircle code. Try the one your family shows you.

auth.forMedicinesHelp.text: You don't need an account. Scan the code your family shows you, and you're in.

auth.forgotHelp.text: Enter the email you signed up with, and we will send you a code to choose a new password.

auth.resetHelp.text: If an account uses this email, we have sent a code to it. It can take a minute to arrive.

auth.codeResent.text: A new code is on its way. Use the newest one.

auth.error.wrongCode.text: That code does not match. Check the most recent email and try again.

auth.error.expiredCode.text: That code has expired. Send a new one and try again.

auth.error.tooMany.text: Too many tries. Please wait a few minutes, then try again.

auth.error.wrongPassword.text: That email and password do not match. Check them, or reset your password.

onboard.intro.text: You will add one parent, connect their phone, and choose who is alerted first if a dose is missed.

onboard.relation.text: How are you related to them?

onboard.parentName.text: Their name, as the family calls them

onboard.connectPhoneHelp.text: Send this link to their phone. It opens DoseCircle and connects the phone with a one-time code. They never need a password.

onboard.shareMessage.text: Please open this link on your phone to get your medicine reminders.

onboard.codeExpires.text: The code works once and expires in 48 hours.

onboard.scanQr.text: Or scan this with their phone's camera.

onboard.enableMineHelp.text: You will be alerted if a dose is missed and it is your turn in the family order.

onboard.enableInstall.text: On iPhone, alerts need the app on your Home Screen first: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen, and open DoseCircle from there.

onboard.enableBlocked.text: Alerts are blocked for this site. Allow notifications for DoseCircle in your browser's site settings, then reload the page.

onboard.enableFailed.text: Alerts could not be turned on. Reload the page and try again.

parent.notify.failed.text: Reminders could not be turned on. Close the app, open it again, and tap the button once more.

invite.invalid.text: This invite did not work. Ask for a new link.

home.allCalm.text: All calm. No doses need attention right now.

home.neverReachable.text: The phone has not been reached yet.

home.yourPosition.text: Your place in the family order

home.notInOrder.text: You are not in the family order for this parent.

home.noMedicines.text: No medicines yet. Photograph a prescription or add them by hand.

home.enableAlerts.text: Alerts are off on this device. Turn them on so you know when it is your turn.

action.testSent.text: A test reminder is on its way to their phone.

action.testFailed.no_medicines.text: No test reminder was sent: there are no medicines to remind them about yet.

action.testFailed.nothing_due.text: No test reminder was sent: none of their medicines is due today.

action.testFailed.paused.text: No test reminder was sent: their reminders are paused.

action.testFailed.no_phone.text: No test reminder was sent: their phone is not connected yet.

action.testFailed.no_notifications.text: No test reminder was sent: their phone has not allowed notifications yet. Ask them to open DoseCircle and turn reminders on.

action.testFailed.limit.text: No test reminder was sent: you can send three a day, and today's are used.

action.testFailed.unknown.text: The test reminder could not be sent. Check your connection and try again.

meds.name.text: Name, exactly as printed on the strip

meds.critical.text: Important medicine: alert the family faster

meds.threshold.text: Warn when this many days are left

meds.stopConfirm.text: Stop reminders for this medicine? Its history stays in the report.

meds.needsWhen.text: Choose at least one time of day, or mark it as needed only.

rx.consent.text: The photo is read by AI: Amazon Textract, then Claude on Amazon Bedrock. It may be processed outside India. Nothing is saved until you check each medicine.

rx.consentCheck.text: I understand and want to continue

rx.printedOnly.text: Works best with printed prescriptions in English. Handwriting is often hard to read, so check every line.

rx.failed.unreadable.text: We could not read this photo. Try again in good light, or add the medicines by hand.

rx.failed.no_medicines.text: We could not find any medicines on this photo.

rx.failed.other.text: Reading failed. Please add the medicines by hand.

rx.pendingTitle.text: A prescription is waiting to be checked

rx.pendingHelp.text: Nothing is added to the reminders until someone checks each medicine.

rx.alreadySaved.text: These medicines have already been checked and saved.

rx.gone.text: This prescription is no longer available. Photos are kept for 7 days.

rx.failed.timeout.text: Reading is taking too long. Try again, or add the medicines by hand.

rx.checkAgain.text: You changed this after ticking it. Check it against the prescription again.

rx.review.text: Check each medicine against the prescription

rx.reviewHelp.text: Nothing is saved until every medicine is checked or removed.

rx.checkedLabel.text: I checked this against the prescription

rx.reason.name_missing.text: The name could not be read.

rx.reason.schedule_missing.text: When to take it is not clear.

rx.reason.no_source_line.text: The line could not be matched to the photo.

rx.reason.low_ocr_confidence.text: The text on this line is faint or blurred.

rx.reason.marked_illegible.text: Part of this line was hard to read.

rx.reason.pattern_unreadable.text: The dose pattern could not be understood.

rx.reason.frequency_unknown.text: The frequency code is not one we know.

rx.reason.frequency_not_daily.text: This is not taken every day, so set the days yourself.

rx.reason.pattern_frequency_conflict.text: The dose pattern and the code disagree.

rx.reason.amount_not_written.text: How many to take was not written.

rx.reason.food_unknown.text: The food instruction is not clear.

rx.reason.duration_unknown.text: How long to take it is not clear.

rx.reason.duration_month_approximate.text: The duration is in months, so the end date is approximate.

rx.reason.no_schedule_found.text: No timing was found for this medicine.

report.subtitle.text: App reminder record. This is not a medical record.

report.none.text: No missed doses in this period.

settings.orderHelp.text: If a dose is missed, the first person is alerted, then the next, then everyone.

settings.pauseHelp.text: For travel or a hospital stay. No reminders are sent while paused.

rx.guardrailRemoved.text: A safety check removed a note that looked like medical advice.

voice.pressGreen.text: When you have taken it, press the green button.

dash.adherenceHint.text: Out of doses with a known outcome. Phone-offline doses are not counted as missed.

dash.responseHint.text: Typical time from alert to someone taking responsibility

dash.consistencyHelp.text: Irregular dose times often come before missed doses.

dash.weekday.text: Missed doses by day and time

dash.reachHelp.text: Hatched days had reminders that never reached the phone.

dash.noData.text: Not enough doses yet to show this.

insight.improving.text: More doses are being taken than in the previous period.

insight.declining.text: Fewer doses are being taken than in the previous period.

insight.strong_week.text: No missed doses in the last week.

insight.slot_slipping.morning.text: Morning doses are being missed more often.

insight.slot_slipping.afternoon.text: Afternoon doses are being missed more often.

insight.slot_slipping.evening.text: Evening doses are being missed more often.

insight.slot_slipping.night.text: Night doses are being missed more often.

insight.irregular_timing.text: Dose times vary a lot, which often comes before missed doses.

insight.refill_soon.text: A medicine is about to run out.

insight.phone_offline_often.text: The phone was unreachable more than once. Check battery saving and mobile data.

parent.readings.prompt.text: Please type in the numbers from the machine.

parent.readings.invalid.text: That number looks wrong. Please check it and type it again.

checks.intro.text: Ask for a reading at the same time as a reminder.

checks.notAdvice.text: DoseCircle writes these numbers down. It never says what they mean: that is for the doctor.

checks.escalates.text: Tell the family if it is forgotten

checks.escalatesHelp.text: The family is alerted in the same order as a missed medicine. Leave this off for a weekly weigh-in.

checks.stopConfirm.text: Stop asking for this reading? The numbers already written down are kept.

checks.already.text: That check is already scheduled. Change the existing one instead.

checks.needsWhen.text: Choose at least one time of day.

checks.noReadings.text: Nothing written down in this period.

people.intro.text: An owner can invite people, remove them, and change who is alerted first.

people.removeConfirm.text: Remove this person from the family? They will stop getting alerts about the parent.

people.leaveConfirm.text: Leave this family? You will stop getting alerts about the parent.

people.lastOwner.text: A family needs at least one owner. Make someone else an owner first.

people.dangerHelp.text: The parent, the medicines, the daily checks, every reading and the whole history are removed. This cannot be undone.

people.dangerConfirmLabel.text: Type the family's name to confirm

parent.today.nothingYet.text: There is nothing to take yet.

parent.today.noneToday.text: There is nothing to take today.

parent.today.familyAdds.text: Your family adds your medicines. They will appear here on their own.

parent.today.weWillTell.text: This phone will ring when it is time. You do not have to remember, and you do not have to open the app.

parent.today.step1.text: This phone rings and shows what to take.

parent.today.step2.text: You press the big green button.

parent.today.step3.text: If you do not, your family is told, one person at a time.

people.inviteHelp.text: Send this to the person you want to add. They sign in once, and after that they are told when a dose is missed.

people.shareMessage.text: Please join our family circle on DoseCircle, so you are told if a dose is missed.

people.addParentHelp.text: Add a second parent, or anyone else in the family who takes daily medicines. Each person gets their own reminders, their own language and their own dashboard.

parent.setup.nameHelp.text: Your family sees this name on their screens.

parent.setup.rxHelp.text: Take a photo of it and your family will add the medicines for you. You can also skip this and do it later.

parent.setup.rxSent.text: Sent to your family. They will check it and add the medicines.

parent.setup.rxConsent.text: The photo is read by a computer and may be processed outside India. Your family checks every line before anything is saved.

people.dependentsHelp.text: Each person here gets their own reminders, in their own language, with their own medicines and dashboard.

home.statusNeedsYou.text: Someone in the family needs you now.

home.statusMissed.text: Not every dose was taken today.

meds.whenHelp.text: The reminder goes to their phone at these times.

meds.whenHelpEditable.text: The reminder goes to their phone at these times. A time here is shared by every medicine taken at that time.

meds.timesSaved.text: The new time is saved. It applies from the next dose.

meds.pillsHint.text: Used to warn the family before the tablets run out. Leave it blank if you would rather not count.

meds.endDateHint.text: Reminders stop after this day. Leave it blank if the medicine continues.

meds.escalationTitle.text: If the reminder is not confirmed

meds.escalationFast.text: This medicine is marked important, so the family is told sooner.

meds.step.nudge.text: A second reminder goes to their phone.

meds.step.first.text: The first person in the family order is alerted.

meds.step.next.text: Then the next person, one at a time.

meds.step.everyone.text: Everyone in the family is alerted.

meds.asNeededHelp.text: No reminders are sent for this medicine, and it does not appear in the daily list.
